settings.question: How should I care for my wood pieces?
settings.answer: Follow the care guidance supplied with your piece. Contact us for product-specific advice before using oils, cleaners, or dishwasher cycles.

settings.question: Can I request a custom piece?
settings.answer: Yes. Share your idea through our custom order inquiry page. Availability, pricing and timing are confirmed individually before an order is placed.

settings.question: Will my piece look exactly like the photo?
settings.answer: Wood grain and color naturally vary. Product photos represent the design; each piece has its own character.
